MARYLAND - UPCOMING - NEWS
US IMMIGRATION MASKED OFFICERSDESCRIPTION: Proposals to prohibit federal immigration agents from masking their faces have gained new life in states — thanks, in part, to a court ruling that blocked the nation's first such law in California. A little over a month after the California law was suspended, Democratic Washington Gov. Bob Ferguson was scheduled Thursday to sign a new law limiting facial coverings on law enforcement officers. More states could soon follow.
